summary: CAIR Action issued a 'Preferred' general-election recommendation for Barrera, running for California's nonpartisan superintendent, while Vote for Peace rated him Neutral. At a May 2026 superintendent forum he expressed concerns about AB 715's classroom effects and committed to defending the antisemitism-education law only when that protects students. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated mission includes supporting Israel, also endorsed him.
